test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: S is shorter than N. P is taller than S. Q is taller than N but shorter than H. N is taller than P. Who will be exactly in the middle if they stand in a row according to height?
solution:
**Persons : **P, Q, N, H and S

1) P is taller than S.

 _ > _ > _ > P > S

2) N is taller than P and S is shorter than N.

 _ > _ > N > P > S

3) Q is taller than N but shorter than H.

 H > Q > **N** > P > S

Hence,** N** is the **correct answer.**
